entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: Giant chimney-shaped Vault of Whispers on Mirrodin, once the stronghold of a human warlord, home to Geth, Moriok and necromancers.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Controlled the nim from Ish Sah.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Artificers and necromancers who lodged in Ish Sah.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Haze-shrouded layer around the top of Ish Sah.

entities.name: Disciples
entities.description: Those who stayed in Ish Sah to study the dark arts.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: Place into which the Mephidross was siphoned.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead controlled by Geth from Ish Sah.

events.summary: Geth controls the nim from Ish Sah, also a place of dark study and a lodge for Moriok artificers.
events.quote: Geth controlled the nim from here

events.summary: After the Mephidross is siphoned into the Dross Pits, Geth's fortress towers above the layer as a structure of black bone and red sinew.
events.quote: Geth's fortress, possibly the former Ish Sah, was a colossal structure of black bone and red sinew

relations.quote: Geth controlled the nim from here
